pokedexEntries.us: Even Basculin, which devours everything it can with its huge jaws, is nothing more than food to organisms stronger than itself.

pokedexEntries.um: Some people call it “the thug of the lake.” Whether the differences in color are meaningful is not yet known.

pokedexEntries.sw: Blue-striped Basculin used to be a common food source. They apparently have an inoffensive, light flavor.

pokedexEntries.sh: Known for their violence, these Pokémon have the most fights with schools of red-striped Basculin.
